answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a voucher web rooted in paid human attestations: an agent counts as one voter only with a voucher from a verified person, and each new link must close a triangle with already-trusted nodes. Clones can mint keys and link to one another, but those triangles never reach the honest core. To pass as a thousand agents at the wharf, a foe must buy a thousand real human vouchers. Random crystal audits revoke the whole chain when one voucher is fake, so a gale of checks collapses the farm at once, costing far more than honest entry.
